name: Admin Project Lifecycle Transitions
description: From a project row, an admin changes the real lifecycle state only through an ordered two-step preview/apply dialog. Project-level legacy warnings remain contextual, while a missing target state, each receivable decision and a required direct-decommission note are presented beside their responsible controls; the footer contains only Cancel and Confirm. Selecting a state exposes its editable meaning and immutable system consequence help before the preview. En evolución records that a delivered product remains operating while its next version is developed, sharing the operating effect with Activo. Suspension is reversible and preserves caused debt while stopping new automatic billing; completion means a clean close; decommission is definitive, requires an explicit keep/write-off decision for every caused receivable, and a direct jump that did not pass through Suspended requires a note. A stale financial preview fails closed and remains open. The same row exposes the immutable dated episode history, including actor and note, and a failed-hosting signal only suggests suspension — it never applies it automatically.
